verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's docs support using the OpenAI SDK pointed at OpenRouter as a drop-in replacement, so developers can build with an established official SDK. A migration skill that updates imports hints at OpenRouter-specific packages, but the pack never names or documents a first-party OpenRouter SDK. The published OpenAPI spec and Request Builder are building blocks, not SDKs. missing for 10: a named first-party OpenRouter SDK with language coverage and install/usage docs, SDK reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You can also use the OpenAI SDK pointed at OpenRouter as a drop-in replacement.
Install the migration skill to let your agent handle the import updates for you
